Your Dashboard has everything: ① Scan Corn to check a sick leaf, ② Community to ask other farmers, and ③ the bell for alerts. Scanning works even without internet or an account.
Scroll down for ① the Outbreak Map. ② The tabs at the bottom switch between Dashboard, your scan History, and Settings. If you lose internet, a banner tells you what still works.
② Take a photo of one sick leaf, or ③ pick one from your gallery. ① shows which barangay your scans are filed under. Tap it to change it in Settings.
In seconds you see ① the disease and ② how sure the app is. A low percentage means the photo was unclear, so try again closer and in good light. ③ is the barangay this scan belongs to.
① gives the first treatment steps, and ② shows the advice was checked against published sources. Tap ③ for the full guide. Every scan is saved to History on its own.
① Treatment lists what to spray, how much, and when. It works offline, so you can read it in the field.
Scroll down for causes, prevention and ① symptoms. ② shows the sources. Always confirm with your DA office or technician before spraying, and follow the product label.

① Share to Community sends this scan to the Outbreak Map so nearby farmers are warned. It does not create a post. You need to be signed in, have your barangay set, and be online. ② The scan is already saved on your phone.

Every scan is kept here. ① Tap a card to see the result and treatment again. ② means it is only on your phone and ③ means it was shared to the map. ④ deletes it from this phone; shared copies stay shared.
Read what farmers near you are seeing. ① Like a post, ② read or add comments, ③ write your own post, and ④ open More. Pull down to refresh.
① Describe what you see, ② tag the disease if you know it, ③ add a photo, then tap ④ Post. Your post is shown under your barangay.
① Comments appear live. ③ Write a reply and the post\'s author gets notified. ② Press and hold someone\'s comment to report it.
Tap ⋮ on ① your own post to edit the text and disease tag, or delete it. On other people\'s posts, ⋮ lets you report them.
See wrong advice, spam or something offensive? ① Pick a reason, ② add details if you like, and ③ send it. An admin reviews it, the person won\'t know it was you, and you won\'t see it again.
Each dot is a verified disease report. ① Search for a place, ② filter what you see, ③ zoom in or out (or pinch), and ④ open the Legend.
① Colour shows how bad it is in that area: red severe (it pulses), amber moderate, green mild, grey reported 2–4 weeks ago. ② The shape and letter show the disease. ③ Each dot is one report.
② Tap any dot to see ① the disease, place, severity, and when it was reported. Tap inside an area\'s outline to see all diseases there.
① Type a barangay or town in Bukidnon. The map flies there and ③ outlines it in blue, and ② shows how many farms are affected.
Show only ② certain diseases or ③ severities. You can pick more than one. ④ shows how many reports match, with Reset to clear. ① The number on the button tells you filters are on.
① Drag this panel up to see ② your barangay\'s ③ verified outbreaks, plus nearby reports from other farmers below them.
Tap the bell on the Dashboard. You\'ll see ② replies to your posts and ③ outbreak alerts for your area. Tap one to open it, or ① mark all as read.

Tap the pencil on your profile card to change your name and barangay. Your barangay decides where scans are filed and what \"near you\" shows. ① Add your farms, ② open this guide again, ③ see the app version, or ④ sign out. You\'re all set!
